title: Ninefold Draft
archiveRole: First Card Strategy Hall observation sample
description: A PC-first card strategy benchmark. Across eight cycles you draft one protocol per cycle, build a small engine, and manage Energy, Focus, and Integrity to reach an Alignment objective against a telegraphed hazard track. The draft offers and hazard order are deterministic, so the run is decided by strategy.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first card strategy benchmark designed for mouse and keyboard at 1440x900 and 1920x1080. Mobile is a no-overflow baseline only: the layout reflows cards to fewer columns to avoid horizontal overflow and the cards stay tappable, but the multi-zone board is intended for desktop. Interactive browser smoke and physical handset QA are pending and not claimed.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. The game, its deterministic draft and hazard system, and its scoring were authored by Claude Code under the no-human-code-edits project rule.
